items.title: Zelensky proposes US military bases in Ukraine as part of security guarantees
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he would welcome American military bases and Western troops in Ukraine as part of security guarantees being discussed outside NATO membership. He acknowledged that he has not received an answer on the presence of US soldiers; Ukraine's constitution currently restricts foreign military bases.

items.title: German defence minister welcomes possible European talks with Putin in Moscow
items.summary: German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius urged European governments not to reject Vladimir Putin's invitation to visit Moscow for talks on Ukraine. He said any initial signal from Putin offering such discussions should be welcomed.

items.title: Dutch weapons maker reportedly says its missiles struck Crimean Bridge on consecutive days
items.summary: Netherlands-based missile and drone manufacturer Destinus reportedly said its RUTA cruise missiles struck the Crimean Bridge on two consecutive days. The reported company statement identifies a weapon system allegedly used in the attacks but does not establish the extent of damage.

items.title: Russia claims strikes hit 12 cargo ships carrying military-related goods to Ukraine
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry claimed that its strikes during November 14–20 hit 12 cargo vessels allegedly delivering military equipment and dual-use goods to Ukraine. It also said Ukrainian port facilities handling military cargo were disabled, without providing vessel identities or an independently established damage assessment.

items.title: Russia warns of response to new EU sanctions and possible seizure of its assets
items.summary: Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said Moscow would respond to additional European Union sanctions and reserved the right to take significant countermeasures if Russian assets were confiscated. Her remarks came amid continuing European discussions over economic pressure on Russia.
